To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the most important geometrical characteristics of SiR insulator in pollution flashover are specific leakage distance and the average diameter of the insulator.
specific leakage distance, shed spacing, average diameter, and shed depth ratio are the most influential design parameters on pollution flashovers of SiR insulator.

(i) The specific leakage distance and the average diameter are the two most important parameters in pollution flashover of SiR insulator; (ii) The salt deposit density, shed spacing to depth ratio, and the form factor are less important; and (iii) The specific leakage and the average diameter have a more significant effect than the salt deposit density, the shed spacing to depth ration, and the form factors on pollution flashover of HVDC insulator.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the contribution of the design parameters of SiR insulator sheds to their pollution flashover performance.
the development of new methods to quantify the significance level of design parameters of insulators in pollution flashover.

the effect of insulator design parameters on their pollution flashover voltage gradient, and it can be considered a step toward a better understanding of the performance of composite/polymeric insulators in HVdc systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the most effective parameter is the specific leakage distance, and the most effective combination would be the specific leakage distance and the average diameter.

the pollution flashover voltage gradient decreases with increasing the salt deposit density, increasing the shed depth, decreasing the specific leakage distance, increasing the average diameter, increasing the shed spacing to shed height ratio, and increasing the form factor.
the specific leakage distance and the average diameter have the most and least impact, respectively, on the flashover performance of HVDC SiRs in severe pollution.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed method is capable of quantifying the contribution of design parameters of SiR insulator to its pollution flashover performance.
the ANN model is able to quantify the contribution of design parameters of insulators to pollution flashover.
the specific leakage distance and the average diameter are the most important parameters in the design of SiR insulator for HVDC applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, for SiR insulator pollution performance, the most important design parameter is the specific leakage distance, which is followed by the average diameter.
the contribution of the parameters to pollution flashover voltage gradient can be determined by the proposed methods.
the design and dimension of SiR insulator sheds are more critical in pollution flashover than in rain.
